status: Candidate implemented and tested; not activated, awaiting explicit visual approval

functional_tests.island_check: PASS: five regions, old world absent, safe spawn, capsule-clear connected quest/region routes and actual player traversal without falls
functional_tests.island_campaign_check: PASS: legacy equipment/quest/health preservation, safe relocation, real cave entry/relic, cave save reload, one-time boar reward and unchanged lantern/dragon progression
functional_tests.island_collision_check: PASS: actual moving-player tree collision, cave spring-arm camera clearance and coastal wading boundary without health penalty
functional_tests.boar_feedback_check: PASS: bounded spatial audio, authored grounded footsteps, distance gating, explicit normal/heavy contact, unchanged damage/stagger/stamina/spirit, short bounded effects and Master mute
functional_tests.boar_check: PASS: boar telegraph, committed dodgeable lane, single contact, invulnerability, wall/LOS collision, grounded collider, stagger, single defeat and death hold
functional_tests.boar_campaign_check: PASS: one optional boar, real dodge/knockback, backward-compatible flag, one-time reward, reload persistence and unchanged camp/retired-wolf IDs
functional_tests.heavy_attack_check: PASS: heavy touch input, stamina cost/gating, delayed 4x damage, forward arc, stagger, spirit, repeat guard, dodge/hit/menu cancellation, pause and death
functional_tests.combat_check: PASS: attack warning, range escape, delayed damage, hit interruption, combo damage and timeout
functional_tests.enemy_check: PASS: Shore/Scout/Brute health, pursuit speed, warning radius/timing, damage, escape, interruption, hit feedback and single defeat
functional_tests.campaign_smoke: PASS: camp, resume, healing, pause, rewards, upgrades, and save reload
functional_tests.autosave_check: PASS: 180ms disk latency without movement stall (dispatch 0.25ms), immutable snapshots, serialized writes, errors/retry, corrupt-save protection, reset and scene exit
functional_tests.persistent_world_check: PASS: persistent island, pickups, cleared demons, waystones, health/potions, death resume, lantern resume, continued exploration and one-time rewards
functional_tests.fast_travel_check: PASS: persistent discovery, invalid/locked destinations, combat/source/destination/boss gates, touch travel, rescue binding and no resource refill
functional_tests.hud_customization_check: PASS: separate gameplay/editor, settings path, touch drag, size/opacity, presets, save/cancel/reset/reopen, safe profiles, failed-write recovery and functional guard/parry
functional_tests.quest_hud_check: PASS: circular bounds/hit areas, separate controls at three resolutions, movement-side sprint, scroll access and incomplete quest guard

desktop_performance.scope: Uncapped native desktop environment review, no Movie Maker; enemies held static for repeatability. Not Android or full-combat FPS acceptance.
